## Engagement model

Five stages, average 60 days from gap to certificate:

1. Gap Analysis — clause-by-clause assessment against the target standard
2. Implementation — documents, controls, and routines built for daily use
3. Internal Audit — trial audit cycle; findings closed before Stage 1
4. Stage 1 & 2 Audit — readiness review and the certification body audit
5. Certification — certificate issued, surveillance plan handed over
